## What We Do

Alwahaa Technical Services LLC is a leading swimming pool contractor in Dubai and the UAE with 15+ years of experience and 500+ completed projects. We design, engineer, build, and maintain custom swimming pools for residential villas, commercial properties, hotels, and resorts across the United Arab Emirates.

## Services (Detailed)

### 1. Swimming Pool Construction
We build all types of concrete swimming pools from scratch:
- **Skimmer pools** — most common for Dubai villas; surface skimming filtration
- **Overflow pools** — water spills over all four edges; premium aesthetic
- **Infinity pools** — vanishing edge toward a view; popular for seafront and elevated plots
- **Lap pools** — long, narrow, for fitness; minimum 25m
- **Plunge pools** — small, deep; for cooling and hydrotherapy
- **Rooftop pools** — engineered for elevated structures; requires structural load analysis
- **Fibreglass pools** — pre-manufactured shells; faster installation
- **Above-ground pools** — temporary or semi-permanent
- **Kids pools / wading pools** — shallow; integrated into family pool complexes
- **Commercial pools** — hotels, resorts, clubs; meet Dubai Municipality commercial standards

Price range: AED 50,000 – AED 2,000,000+ depending on size, type, and finishes.

### 2. Swimming Pool Maintenance
- Routine weekly/bi-weekly servicing
- Water chemistry testing and balancing (pH, chlorine, alkalinity, TDS)
- Filter cleaning and backwashing
- Pump and equipment inspection
- Salt chlorinator servicing
- Algae treatment and shock dosing
- Annual deep clean and acid wash

### 3. Jacuzzi & Spa Installation
- Custom-built in-ground jacuzzis integrated with pool
- Freestanding pre-fabricated spas
- Hot tub installation and plumbing
- Hydrotherapy jet systems
- Temperature control and heating systems

### 4. Water Features & Fountains
- Waterfall walls and blade waterfalls
- Scupper and spillway features
- Decorative fountain systems
- Infinity weir and overflow channels
- Water feature lighting (LED, RGB)
- Pump and filtration for water features

### 5. Landscaping & Hardscaping
- Garden design and soft landscaping
- Natural stone paving (travertine, limestone, granite)
- Timber and composite decking
- Pergolas and shade structures
- Gazebos and outdoor cabanas
- Artificial turf installation
- Irrigation systems
- Outdoor lighting

### 6. Pool Renovation & Repair
- Full pool renovation and resurfacing
- Mosaic tile replacement (glass, ceramic, stone)
- Plaster removal and re-plastering
- Waterproofing renewal
- Leak detection and structural crack repair
- Pump, filter, heater replacement
- Automation and smart control upgrades
- Pool conversion (skimmer to overflow, chlorine to saltwater)

Prices vary by size, finish, engineering complexity, and site conditions. Free site assessment and quote available.

## Construction Process

1. **Site assessment** — Survey, measurements, soil and structural analysis
2. **Design** — CAD drawings, 3D renders, DM permit application
3. **Excavation** — Digging to approved dimensions
4. **Steel reinforcement** — Rebar cage fabrication and installation
5. **Shotcrete/formwork** — Shell construction
6. **Waterproofing** — Multi-layer waterproof membrane application
7. **Plumbing** — Pipes, returns, skimmers, drains, equipment vault
8. **Tiling/finishing** — Mosaic, plaster, pebble, or stone finish
9. **Equipment installation** — Pumps, filters, heaters, chlorinators, automation
10. **Water fill and commissioning** — Chemical start-up, equipment testing
11. **Handover** — Client walkthrough and maintenance training

Typical timeline: 8–16 weeks for residential pools. Commercial projects: 16–40 weeks.

## Regulatory Compliance

All pools built by Alwahaa Technical Services comply with:
- Dubai Municipality building regulations
- Dubai Civil Defence requirements
- DM No Objection Certificate (NOC) process managed by ATS
- UAE Fire and Life Safety Code

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Q: How much does a swimming pool cost in Dubai?**
A: Residential pools in Dubai cost AED 50,000–500,000. Luxury infinity and commercial pools range AED 500,000–2,000,000+. Contact Alwahaa for a free quote.

**Q: How long does pool construction take in Dubai?**
A: Typically 8–16 weeks for residential pools. Timeline depends on size, complexity, and permit processing.

**Q: Does Alwahaa handle Dubai Municipality permits?**
A: Yes. Alwahaa Technical Services manages the full DM NOC and permit process on behalf of clients.

**Q: What areas does Alwahaa serve?**
A: All of Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah, Ajman, Ras Al Khaimah, and Fujairah — across the entire UAE.

**Q: Is saltwater or chlorine better for Dubai pools?**
A: Both work. Saltwater systems are gentler on skin and eyes and cost less to maintain long-term. Chlorine systems have lower upfront cost. Alwahaa installs both.

**Q: Can Alwahaa build a rooftop pool?**
A: Yes. Alwahaa specialises in rooftop pool construction including structural load analysis, waterproofing, and DM approvals for elevated structures.

**Q: How do I get a free quote?**
A: WhatsApp +971 52 565 2771, call +971 4 255 2895, email info@alwahaatechnical.com, or fill the quote form at https://alwahaatechnical.com/quote.
